We’re happy to help you compare options. Based on our general offerings, two very popular choices are:

Hybrid mattress

Combines springs + foam for support + pressure relief
Great for heavier individuals needing strong support and resilience
Often a good “all‑rounder” for many sleep positions

Memory foam mattress

Contours closely to your body for strong pressure relief
Good if you value a more “hugging,” cushioned feel

Which is better for you?

If you’re over ~230 lb, or prioritize strong support and bounce → Hybrid is usually better.
If you mainly want plush pressure relief and body‑conforming comfort → Memory foam is usually better.
If you’re unsure of firmness, a medium‑firm (4–6) feel suits most people.
Choose mattress size based on how many people will sleep on it and your height (Twin for one, Queen for most couples, King/Cal King for more space).
Consider accessories like pillows and a gel memory foam topper if you want extra neck support or added cushioning and cooling.

If you share your weight range, sleep position (side/back/stomach/mixed), and whether you sleep hot, we can narrow down which of these two types fits you best.
